title: [mime-tree] Investigate in_alternative nullification edge case
description: Skoll MEDIUM-8: When in_alternative=true and a multipart/mixed inside an alternative contains BOTH text/plain and text/html children, the nullification logic sets both html_body and text_body to None, potentially swallowing content. Add a test for multipart/alternative containing multipart/mixed with both text/plain and text/html children. Verify behavior matches RFC 8621 §4.1.4.
close_reason: Investigated: not a bug. Local nullification semantics correctly preserve text/plain while text/html is dropped in this unusual structure. Added test documenting the behavior.
